description.narrative: (Cambodia): Enhancing Quality of Healthcare Activity (EQHA) will improve the quality of public and private health facilities to develop and implement patient-centered quality improvement (QI) plans. With FY 2021 funds, EQHA will institutionalize QI approaches within the sub-national health system by increasing local management and ownership, integrating disease-specific QI needs into the routine public health assessment system, and strengthening a national performance-based incentive program. EQHA will work with the public and private sector to improve modern contraceptive use, tuberculosis case detection, and HIV/AIDS integration. EQHA will partner with health professional associations and councils to promote a continuing professional development system to strengthen regulation and licensing reform efforts and will support the implementation of the new management of health services law that includes an accreditation system. EQHA will work with health training institutions to reform training methodologies to produce better-trained healthcare providers. EQHA will continue to build on its quality improvement platform to improve the Cambodian health system's preparation, detection, and response to COVID-19 community transmission in Cambodia..EQHA supports the Administration's priorities to enhance U.S. leadership in responding to the disruption and suffering caused by the global COVID-19 pandemic. EQHA will also support the development and application of information technology platforms, data, and tools to support health workforce capacity, promote e-referral systems, and foster transparent and accountable healthcare systems to respond to citizens' needs. EQHA contributes to USAID/Cambodia's CDCS 2020-2025 Development Objective 2, "Health, Education, and Welfare of Cambodians Improved Through Enhanced Services.".
